_meta: Fasttel catalog scraped 2026-06-08 from galtechtrading.com (brand page) + shop.fasttel.com (Odoo store). is_new is recomputed by the builder from the live Framer export, not trusted from here. tags are filtered to the Framer-allowed set by the builder (e.g. 'intercom' is dropped). datasheet_url galtech PDFs are vendor URLs that drop on import; the builder prefers the mirrored Assets/fasttel/<slug>/<slug>_datasheet.pdf and falls back to the FT600-family PDF for entry-series variants.

products.title: FT600SIP
products.sub_title: Doorphone entry outdoor station, no camera, no keypad
products.description: The FT600SIP is a standalone outdoor station with 2 usable SIP accounts that can be activated simultaneously. FT600W monitors and FT600APP smartphone apps can be ordered for this outpost in addition to using the 2nd SIP account. The outpost has one push button. The supplied black-anodized housing allows on- and flush-mounting (216x116mm).

products.title: FT600SIP-3
products.sub_title: Doorphone entry outdoor station, 3 SIP accounts, no camera
products.description: The FT600SIP-3 is a standalone outdoor station with 3 usable SIP accounts that can be activated simultaneously. FT600W monitors and FT600APP smartphone apps can be ordered for this outpost. The outpost has one push button and a black-anodized housing for on- and flush-mounting.

products.title: FT600KSIP
products.sub_title: Doorphone entry outdoor station with keypad, no camera
products.description: The FT600KSIP is a standalone outdoor station with keypad and 2 usable SIP accounts that can be activated simultaneously. Black-anodized housing for on- and flush-mounting (216x116mm).

products.title: FT600KSIPVC
products.sub_title: Doorphone entry video station with keypad and color camera

FT600W monitors and FT600APP smartphone apps can be ordered in addition. The outpost has one push button. Black-anodized housing for on- and flush-mounting (216x116mm).

products.title: FT2501IP
products.sub_title: Wizard Elite IP grey - 1 button, no camera, no keypad
products.description: The Wizard Elite IP is one of Fasttel's showpieces, combining high-end design with strong technical characteristics, making it usable in both residential and industrial projects. It can be fitted with an Ekey fingerprint reader seamlessly integrated into the aluminium frame. This variant has one button, no camera and no keypad.

RGB LEDs and a freely selectable frame colour let it fit any exterior. It has an integrated Wiegand/proximity reader for residents, communicates with any SIP/VoIP device in a home, and this variant adds an integrated camera and keypad for access codes.

products.title: FT30CC
products.sub_title: 10" HD all-in-one indoor station (Commander)
products.description: The COMMANDER (FT30CC) is an all-in-one 10" HD indoor monitor that records visitors, displays the cameras around your property, works as a phone, connects to home automation systems and serves as an alarm clock. It runs Android 12 with Google Play Store access and functions as a videophone, surveillance monitor and Android tablet.

products.title: FTBG30CC
products.sub_title: Commander 10" HD all-in-one indoor station, bronze gold
products.description: The COMMANDER is an all-in-one device that has no equal: among other things it records your visitors, displays all the cameras around your property, is a phone, provides a connection to any home automation system, and is an alarm clock. It features a 10" HD touchscreen, Wi-Fi 6, Android 12 with Google Play Store, support for up to 50 IP cameras, a built-in SIP phone and voice assistance. This is the bronze-gold finish.

products.title: FTBG30CC + FTBG30CCDESK

It records visitors, displays up to 50 integrated IP cameras, offers voice assistance, an integrated SIP phone and third-party apps via Google Play Store. This bundle is the bronze-gold Commander combined with its matching desk stand (FTBG30CCDESK).

products.title: FT600VK Kit (without keypad)

products.title: FT9000
products.sub_title: Door controller for 4 doors with web/cloud access
products.description: The FT9000 is a door access controller for up to 4 doors with web and cloud access. It is housed in a robust steel enclosure with status LEDs and is compatible with Wiegand card readers, QR-code readers and keypads. It provides alarm outputs (power outage, low battery, tampering, fire) for integration with alarm systems and is managed via Fasttel's cloud platform and smartphone app.

specs.label: Alarm outputs
specs.value: Power outage, low battery, tamper, fire

products.title: FT23K
products.sub_title: Stand-alone access keypad, 2 relays + Wiegand
products.description: The FT23K is a stand-alone access keypad with 2 relays and Wiegand output, available in surface- or flush-mounted versions and in various aluminium and bronze finishes. It is used for code-based door access and integrates with Wiegand controllers.

products.title: FT24K
products.sub_title: Stand-alone access keypad (via FT25KINT) and Wiegand
products.description: The FT24K is a stand-alone access keypad that operates via the FT25KINT interface and Wiegand output, in a 143x143mm front plate available in grey aluminium and bronze finishes (gold, fusil, rustic) or a custom RAL colour. It is used for code-based door access.

products.title: FT25K
products.sub_title: Access keypad in glass, stand-alone (via FT25KINT) and Wiegand
products.description: The FT25K is a stand-alone access keypad set in glass, operating via the FT25KINT interface and Wiegand output, in a 150x150mm format. This variant has a grey glass front (a black version, FTB25K, is also available). It is used for code-based door access.

products.title: FT26K
products.sub_title: Keypad / badge reader with Bluetooth, NFC, Wiegand and cloud
products.description: The FT26K is a combined keypad and badge reader with Bluetooth and NFC support, one relay, Wiegand output and cloud connectivity, in a black aluminium housing (50x140x28mm). It supports access via code, badge or smartphone and is managed through Fasttel's cloud platform.

products.title: FTEMPEROR-V
products.sub_title: Stainless steel base for the FTEMPEROR design column
products.description: The FTEMPEROR-V (FTEMPERORV) is a stainless steel base for the FTEMPEROR design registration/intercom column (250x180x8mm). It provides extra stability on uneven surfaces. It is a mounting accessory for the Emperor pedestal columns used with FT800 Prestige outdoor stations.
